name: Highlight
description: Full-stack observability platform with session replay and error monitoring.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Sign in to https://app.highlight.io as a workspace admin/owner.
2. Open Workspace Settings > API Tokens.
3. Create a new API token (or reuse one) that has admin / owner privileges on the workspace you want audited.
4. Copy the token and paste it above.

Note: Highlight's public API surface for workspace data is limited. The employee-access check uses the private GraphQL endpoint (pri.highlight.run/graphql). If Highlight rejects the workspace_admins query for your token, the check will surface that explicitly so you can either upgrade the token's scope or upload the admin list as manual evidence.
